items.title: Cloudflare Jumps 11%, Nebius Surges 9% as AI Cloud Stocks Defy NVIDIA’s Slide; CoreWeave Rallies 6% on Wayve Deal
items.summary: While NVIDIA slides on a startling report about its CEO, the cloud companies that buy its chips are drawing buyers back. One of them just posted what its CEO calls a best-ever quarter, but a few numbers underneath complicate the celebration.

items.title: Nvidia Isn’t Staying in The $180s for Long
items.summary: A political earthquake in Washington and a boardroom investigation into its CEO have rattled Nvidia shares, yet analysts keep raising their numbers. Two upcoming answers could decide which side of this standoff turns out to be right.

items.title: Skydance Earnings Will Put Its Streaming Strategy to the Test
items.summary: Skydance reports third-quarter earnings after the closing bell Monday, and analysts’ expectations are modest.

items.title: Microsoft Borrows at “10 Percentage Points Below CoreWeave.” Now It’s Backing Away From Neoclouds
items.summary: Key TakeawaysMicrosoft wants fewer neocloud partners and won’t renew one of its cloud contracts with Oracle, CNBC reported on Friday. Citi’s Steven Wieting says Microsoft’s cost of debt is about 10 percentage points below CoreWeave’s.

items.title: Google Pushes New AI Chips. Why There Could Be an Opening.
items.summary: Alphabet’s Google is expanding its AI hardware lineup with systems designed for sensitive data and large workloads.

items.title: AMD Stock Could Jump 34%. No, It’s Got Nothing to Do With the Nvidia Turmoil.
items.summary: Oppenheimer analyst Rick Schafer expects AMD’s data-center sales to surge 135% next year thanks to robust AI spending.

items.title: Is Oracle (ORCL) Losing Ground In AI Infrastructure Demand?
items.summary: Oracle (NYSE: ORCL) is losing a cloud AI rental arrangement as Microsoft winds down use of Oracle infrastructure tied to older Nvidia chips. ING plans to sell a large portfolio of data center loans that includes a major Oracle related AI project involving OpenAI and SoftBank. Both the Microsoft exit and ING loan sale raise fresh questions about demand for Oracle linked AI infrastructure projects. Take a look at 4 other big wins we have identified for Oracle. Consider widening your research...

items.title: Dell and HPE Were AI Winners Until the Selloff. Can Earnings Put Them Back on Track?
items.summary: Dell and HPE both erased roughly 40% of their AI-fueled gains in a month, and two earnings reports land within days of each other. One company's cash flow and the other's networking bet will decide which rebound is real.
